nom: L'Oréal Revitalift Vitamin C Vitamin E Salicylic Acid Serum

avis.titre: Worst vitamin C serum on the market
avis.texte: I usually dont write reviews but this product was so awful I would be doing others a disservice if i didnt share a disclaimer about how awful this is. It oxidizes on the skin (it was subtle at first but became more noticeable in time). The skin under my eyebrows and bridge of my nose turned orange. It has an awful smell and strange formulation. Better off night including a vitamin c serum in your routine than using this. I dont think ive ever used another beauty product i've been so disappointed with. Zero stars. Cant possibly recommend! Loreal needs to remove this product from their shelves asap.
Im on my 4th bottle . I do have to make sure I keep it in cool storage and that I close tightly. Other than that no complaints.
This smells so bad, I literally had to wash my face after putting it on. Gross!

I had bought this before and it was good but decided to try other recommendations, at first it burned a bit after washing my face alone, but now I put toner then this and moisturizer and it been doing well I have tried many brands even le Mer, but all others have made me very irritated and peel painfully I just recovered and decided to go back to this and with the night midnight moisturizer its been great.
I usually buy my vit c from Marshall, but this time I wanted to try a different one. I bought the vit c and the musturizer moisturizer at Ulta. After 2 weeks my skin is burning and peeling so bad.
I started using this stuff and overall liked it then i befan noticing it would leave an orange residue in my face hours later.

This product gave me the worst deep, cystic acne I've ever had in my life. It took weeks to heal and has now left me with scars all over my face. As soon as I stopped using it the acne began to clear. This is going straight into the garbage.
I fiSnlly figired out this is what causes a nice roundid acne. Ugh in so mad. Oxidized fast. Smells terrible anyway.
i wanted to love this product so much but it pills so bad. Bad under makeup & even on its own

avis.titre: Nice texture, but unable to use
avis.texte: I enjoyed texture of this serum and it absorbs nicely. However, it oxidizes during the day, giving my face an orange tint. When I trued to use it at night, it stained/ruined my pillowcase. This is a pass for me.

I'm not sure why the reviews initially seem so high for this product. No matter how much I apply, how long I wait, or what products I use with it this product builds up on the skin. I've never had a problem with pilling until I added this to my skincare routine. I would not buy again or recommend.

So this serum does do its job; however, be prepared to have to pull pieces of orange pulp off your face throughout the day. I will unfortunately not be repurchasing simply because the pulp interferes with my other products in my regimen.

I don't even know if it actually works because I couldn't stand the smell. It smells just like bleach and it's super strong. I'm pretty disappointed in this product and I was really hoping it would work.

I bought this because i have textured, acne prone skin. I really liked the serum - it felt nice on my skin and absorbed well (or so i thiught). After about 3 hours, i realized it had oxidized on my face. As a fair skin girl, it was incredibly obvious that there was an orange film on my face and neck.

avis.titre: Second time I've bought this product
avis.texte: It works for me. I didn't experience any breakouts or irritation. I use it only once per day, in the morning.

Feels like it leaves an orange film on my face more than it absorbs into the skin. With how many good reviews it has, I'm a little surprised by how much I don't like it. At least it's at a lower price point.

avis.titre: If you struggle with adult acne, this is for you.
avis.texte: This may not be the ~perfect~ product, but it sure as heck does an amazing job. Within a month, I noticed my skin retaining more moisture, my persistent acne clearing, and my face less oily after a long day. The key to not letting it oxidize as quickly is to apply it were needed quickly, and the honestly not dilly-dallying when screwing the cap on. This serum lives on my bathroom sink, and it took about a month to become fully oxidized (and that's because I didn't use it religiously at the end of it's lifecycle - a girl just was letting her whole skincare routine go for a bit 🙃). Even with oxidation, the product still does it's job, you just need to apply more. The pilling is your issue layering products (I said what I said). To avoid the 'oompa loompa' face, you should get a mineral primer. It basically resets your skin/base back to normal color. Now, all of that, I don't think I'd tell cooler undertones to buy this product, because you'll be disappointed. But for all of my warm tone gals, yeah - I totally recommend this just based off effectiveness and price.

I use this as my daily serum, I love how it helps decrease the oil production on my face. I usually apply it after my Clinique toner, then cover it with a moisturizer. Honestly, I don't know what the negative reviews are talking about, its perfect!
I like this vitamin c but it literally leaves you orange if you have fair skin this prob isn't the best option
This Vitamin c oxidized very quickly, has a strong scent, and a thicker consistency than most. Much better options out there.
I wanted to love this, but no matter how I apply it… it results in the product pilling and leaving a film on my skin that just rubs off. Unfortunate.
Made me break out like crazy. I even used the whole bottle to give my skin a real chance to get used to it, and the little pimples would not go away. It stings when applied also.

I've used the vitamin c serum with ferulic acid and salicylic acid for a month now and my face has never looked this good. Hands down my favorite everyday serum and it's affordable! I'm almost at the end of this bottle but will be repurchasing. This worked better on my skin than the most expensive one, the skinceuticals C E Ferulic acid serum. Thank you L'Oréal for making products that everyone can afford while maintaining high formulation standards.
I like the brightening part of the serum and the ease of applying it. It was a free sample #GiftedbyLorealParis and I thank them for letting me try it.

I really wanted to love this one, I use the Revitalift derm intensives at 10% vitamin c. That was out of stock so I tried this one ! Should be better, vitamin C is at 12% now right? Boy was I wrong! This one leaves a film over my skin that seems to roll off as I rub it. It also made me break out a lot I returned it and went back to my Revitalift!!
I used this only at night and it left an orange hue all over my face even after washing it in the morning. Beware.
I received a sample of this product & while I admit it did slightly tingle (vitamin c oil always does), it made my face feel smooth & silky. I plan to purchase! #GiftedbyLorealParis

No no no. This is SUPER fragranced and already oxidized when i opened the bottle (serum was dark brown/orange). Also, when i rubbed my skin, it was pilling. I cant imagine makeup going over it either. Definitely returned and do not recommend.

Wish I had read the negative reviews first, because they are true! Not sure if I purchased a bad bottle, but this serum turned my face orange after only one use. I applied in the morning and let it set before applying moisturizer and then a powder foundation. By mid-day, I noticed a weird brownish/orange discoloration along my hair line and on the dry parts of my face. This type of oxidization has never occurred from my current products, so I know it was the serum. It also made my skin feel slightly sticky and like it never fully absorbed. Do not recommend, and cannot wait to return this product.

It is my first time using vitamin C serum, and I'm pretty happy with this product. One expression line that I had has been smoothed since I started using it, and the pores have become smaller as well.

I requested a sample of this serum to try since I have sensitive skin and worry about using some products and having burning or itching. I was happy surprised how much I liked this. It wasn't sticky and wore well under foundation or powder. I had no reaction or sensitivity to the serum. It had a very minimal, clean scent. I plan to buy this product. #GiftedbyLorealParis
Will send photo as soon as I get samples.thank you for everything

I love it. I need some of it so much. I would like to try it please and thank you. I need it for my face. My skin totally needs a refresh start anyways. Thanks happy turkey day thank you so much. Have a good day OK.
I use Vitamin C Vitamin E Salicylic Acid Serum in the morning after washing my face and before applying L'Oreal's moisturizer with broad spectrum sunscreen, and I am very pleased with my complexion.

I bought this with my points but I disliked it so much I went back to exchange it for something else. The smell was almost like laundry detergent and the serum inside the dropper was brown like it was beginning to go bad. The fact it incorporates salicylic acid with the vitamin C is actually really good for your skin but I couldn't get past its smell and the dropper (which also didn't work well).

Bought this and within 1 week it was oxidized, now its lost its potency. I stored it with all my other products in a cool and dark place. The amell is not bery pleasant either. There's other options where you wont loose your money.
I received this a a free sample, I have to say it wasn't a lot but the feeling was pleasant it gave my skin a luxurious touch!

I didn't mind the smell when I first put it on in the morning. I hardly look at myself in the mirror throughout the day. When I was taking my makeup off at the end of the day, I realized it oxidized and my entire face and neck were completely orange.

The serum turns orange, which means it oxidized and lots its effectiveness, half way through the bottle. I bought it a second time thinking it was perhaps an unstable batch but same thing happen. Don't waste your money in it.

avis.titre: Smells gross and turns hands orange
avis.texte: This stuff smells weird coming out of the bottle and then all day long I can smell it permeating off me like I just got done with a tanning session. And after just a few days of using, it turned my palms orange. Don't like the smell and I don't like the orange. I only gave it two stars because I didn't have enough time to see any affects and I don't want to keep doing this to my hands and I don't want to keep smelling this way.

avis.titre: Skeptical new user concerned about the smell!
avis.texte: Just started using….but the smell is quite off-putting! And it does not fade away as it dries, only intensifies as your skin warms the product.
I was skeptical but this really works. My skin is clearer and more radiant. Luscious really, darling. Plus you can usually get free samples and/or a discount and we love a deal.

avis.titre: Do you know now to make your skin glow ?
avis.texte: I admit right away that I only have a miniature, but since the tool is used very sparingly, it lasted me 10 days. And during this time, you can already form an opinion. I used it as a 2in1 serum + cream. That is, after applying the concentrate, I did not apply the cream additionally, because I felt that the cream would already be superfluous. I would like to separately note the pleasant warming effect after application. At the first application, I was a little scared, I thought that maybe it was an allergic reaction. And this moment should not be excluded, because earlier I mentioned the high content of ascorbic acid. But no, everything worked out, and the warmth is not accompanied by reddening of the skin. The concentrate absorbs very quickly. I am satisfied with the result. Skin, as if I drank a course of vitamins.
I use this every morning and absolutely love it. First week I broke out bc if the acid, but pores look dramstically better now. This is just as good as the skinceuticals vit c, but much cheaper.
This is such a great product! Super brightening I'd recommend to a friend.

This is a #giftedbylorealparis honest review. I received a small trial-size product, so I couldn't tell the long time results, but instantly you can feel how your skin absorbs it, and it glows. It has a light consistency, and it is easy to apply.

Everyones skin is different so it might've been the reason these bumps showed up but eitherway from my experience, i wouldn't recommend this product.

With consistent use, this serum can be a valuable addition to your skincare arsenal.
